verdict.rationale: First-party docs state QuickBooks Payroll will calculate, file, and pay federal and state payroll taxes, with guaranteed-accurate calculations and up to $25,000 in tax penalty protection; experts handle tax filing and payroll can run automatically. Local taxes are never mentioned, so a named part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of local payroll tax calculation, filing, and remittance; independent or hands-on corroboration of automated filing and remittance.
